title: Employees who use AI most may need greater clarity about what adoption means for them
discussion_signal: Gallup frames frequent AI use and job-displacement concern as coexisting, making manager communication, evaluation rules, skill continuity, and worker voice part of adoption. Replies add competing interpretations: frequent users may see capability changes earlier, while non-users may not yet see the risk.
linked_research_question: How does workplace discussion connect AI exposure to displacement fear, managerial buffering, evaluation transparency, and worker control?
limits: Discussion does not establish causal effects of AI use on displacement fear
LinkedIn engagement is self-selected and not a workforce sample
Public search discovery is not a platform-native Creator/API export
